caption: This drawing consists of a central rectangular area containing several lines of text written in colored letters, mainly in shades of blue, red, and green. The rectangular text area is bordered by a double-line frame with small diamond shapes in the corners and scattered throughout the border. Surrounding this central panel is a decorative border featuring a repeated diamond pattern; inside some diamonds there are stylized floral designs and hearts colored in light blue, pale pink, black, and red. Along the top and sides of the border, there are green vine-like decorations with pink flower buds or leaves at each intersection. In the lower portion of the drawing, below the text, there are three squares: the left and right squares each contain a plant with green leaves and red berries, likely strawberries, and the middle square depicts a house with a pitched roof, several windows, and a door, flanked by trees, with birds perched on both the trees and the roof. A smaller dark green tree with two birds appears to the left of the house, and a potted plant with light blue flowers appears to the right of the house. The overall color palette is predominantly green, pink, blue, red, and black, with the background showing an off-white or cream color. The edges of the fabric are slightly uneven, suggesting a handmade or hand-stitched appearance.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
